summary: Phase 3 Resume Version Comparison (/app/compare) tested end-to-end. All 16 assertions passed: empty state, seed/hydration, default selectors (A=Master Profile, B=first resume), score columns with 'Higher' trophy badge, category breakdown (6 rows with trophies), skills diff (Only in A=React/TypeScript/CSS, In both=Node, Only in B=Python/PostgreSQL/Docker for Frontend CV vs Backend CV), word-level summary diff with del/add tokens, and the discoverability 'compare-link' button on /app/resumes navigating to /app/compare.

issues:
Legend tokens 'Removed in B' (line-through red) and 'Added in B' (green) are rendered as inside a

at top of the summary-diff section. They are styled identically to actual diff tokens, so automated/heuristic readers can confuse the legend with real diff tokens. Consider wrapping the legend in a dedicated container/role or using a different element/class so it's distinguishable from actual diff output.

Score on the left (Version A) is rendered to the right of its bar (bar then number) which can be slightly confusing because the bar fills from the right; current layout is functional but the visual association of each bar with its side could be clearer with explicit A/B labels above each column.

critical_code_review_comments: lib/compare.ts diffWords currently splits on whitespace via /(\s+)/ — this keeps whitespace tokens in output which is correct, but the LCS dp builds an (n+1)x(m+1) table; for very long summaries (>500 words) memory could grow. Not an issue for resume summaries but worth noting.

app/compare/page.tsx: Default Version B is computed only via `bId || (resumes[0]?.id ?? PROFILE_ID)`. If a user manually picks Master Profile (value '__profile__') for B, that selection is preserved correctly since bId is then truthy. OK.
Summary diff legend uses identical class names ('line-through', 'green-600') as actual diff tokens — this is a minor styling/UX coupling concern (see design_issues).

Console warning observed on every page: 'Encountered a script tag while rendering React component'. Pre-existing across pages (not introduced by Phase 3). Worth a separate cleanup ticket — likely a stray <script> in a layout/component being rendered server-side.
Score column shows 'X roles · Y skills' with no plural handling ('1 roles'). Minor i18n/copy nit.
action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Differentiate the summary-diff legend styling so legend chips don't share identical classes with real diff tokens.
(Optional) Fix '1 roles' / '1 skills' singular-plural display in ScoreColumn.
(Optional/separate) Investigate the global 'Encountered a script tag while rendering React component' console error — pre-existing, not Phase 3 specific.
seed_data_creation: Injected the provided SEED JSON into localStorage key 'applypilot_v4'. Verified parsing in browser: 2 resumes (Frontend CV, Backend CV) with expected skills 'React, TypeScript, CSS, Node' and 'Node, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Compare feature is fully functional. Use SEED file at /tmp/seed_str.txt (created via /tmp/mkseed2.py) for future regression. Note: SEED must be valid JSON without raw newlines in bullets — use json.dumps to serialize. The Next.js app runs via supervisor 'nextapp' on port 3000; external URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Phase 1 & Phase 2 are already verified in iteration_1 / iteration_2 — do not retest unless code touches them.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in Phase 3. All compare flows (empty state, default selection, score rings, category breakdown with trophy winners, skills set-diff, word-level summary diff, and the discoverability link on /app/resumes) work as specified.
